resources.string: This phone first, then as few and as large helpers as needed. Skips helpers when the model fits here.
Every selected device gets a share in proportion to its memory.
You choose the percent of the model each device holds. Values are used exactly.
You choose how many layers each device holds. Values are used exactly.
Enter a whole number of at least 1 for every device.
The percentages must add up to 100 %% (now %1$d %%).
The layers must add up to %1$d (now %2$d).

Fix the split values in the advanced settings before starting.
